assets.generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW complete mechanical defense turret building sprite for an original 2D RTS videogame. Reference image 1 is the EXACT official software logo to preserve faithfully as a small inset enamel badge on the front armor plate; reproduce its shape and colors without inventing a replacement logo. Reference image 2 is ONLY the V4 industrial rendering style, material palette and camera reference: do not copy its data-center structure. Camera fixed orthographic steep 65-degree overhead 3/4 view. Crisp detailed miniature industrial game art, ivory armor #F2F0E9, charcoal steel #101316, restrained amber service details, matching source rendering. SQUARE 1:1 CANVAS, centered full object, the entire turret and full foundation fit inside central 68% width and height, at least 16% truly transparent margin on ALL four sides. ACTUALLY TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND, no ground, scenery, gradient, checkerboard, external shadows or glow. No people, no animation sequence, no border, no UI. No lettering except logo already supplied. Subject: VS CODE PRECISION FIXED TURRET. Sturdy low octagonal fixed foundation bolted to base, a rotating dark turret head carrying ONE long precise rectangular railgun barrel pointing toward lower-left of image, ivory angular armor panels with rich VS Code blue side plates and cyan aiming aperture, compact exposed heat sink behind the gun, two short blue power conduits. Entire barrel contained within central safe area. Exact blue ribbon VS Code logo from image 1 visibly inset on flat front base armor; do not replace or reinterpret it. This is a grounded stationary defense building, no legs or wheels.
